segments.line: Because her room isn't a room anymore.
Your little sister is the size of the house.
She laughs, and every window on the street rattles.
Here's what you didn't know: the word works for anyone who hears it.
She waves at the whole street.
She picks up the cat, very gently.
Blood is heavy. At ten times her height, her heart has to push it ten times higher.
That takes about three times the pressure her heart can make.
And without blood, a brain switches off in about ten seconds.
There's only one way to catch her.
Then you both sit down, and wait. Slowly, the street gets bigger again.
Across the street, the man in the suit isn't calling for help.
The next morning, there's a card on your pillow.

insert: crutch tip, then the cast, step by step
the landing: he shoulders her door; gold light round its edges

shots.line: Because her room isn't a room anymore.

shots.line: She laughs, and every window on the street rattles.
shots.note: the house across the road: every window rattles

shots.line: Here's what you didn't know: the word works for anyone who hears it.
shots.note: close-up: Pip below, looking up; gold rings

shots.line: She waves at the whole street.
shots.note: wide: she waves; tiny Mo and Mum wave back
the doorstep: Mum faints, gets up, faints again

shots.line: She picks up the cat, very gently.
shots.note: insert: the cat on her giant palm
wide: she sways, stars round her head

shots.line: Blood is heavy. At ten times her height, her heart has to push it ten times higher.
shots.note: schematic: heart to brain 0.3 m, at ×10 3 m; blood is heavy

shots.line: That takes about three times the pressure her heart can make.
shots.note: schematic: what her heart makes (~80) vs what 3 m needs (~235): ×3

shots.line: And without blood, a brain switches off in about ten seconds.
shots.note: schematic: no blood to the brain, a 10 s countdown
extreme close-up: her eyes going, red rim
wide: the dial 00:10 over the street, Pip small below

shots.line: There's only one way to catch her.
shots.note: close-up: Pip decides; gold comes into his eyes
wide: GROW: he grows in the street, cast and all
insert: the cast, huge, cracking along its length
wide: one limping giant step toward the house
wide: she topples out of the roof; 9, 8
wide: he catches her; the gold flares

shots.line: Then you both sit down, and wait. Slowly, the street gets bigger again.
shots.note: night: both sit on the street and shrink back

shots.line: Across the street, the man in the suit isn't calling for help.
shots.note: the man in the suit, phone up, filming
insert: his phone screen: the two giants, REC

shots.line: The next morning, there's a card on your pillow.
shots.note: the bedroom next morning: a card on the pillow
insert, top-down: the card, one word, too blurred to read
close-up: Pip, wide awake
end card: PART 2 / WHAT DO YOU THINK IT SAYS?
